question: The government tracks the performance of eight core industries to monitor industrial activity. What is the approximate weight of the core industries in the Index of Industrial Production (IIP)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The eight core industries of India have a combined weight of approximately **40.27%** in the Index of Industrial Production (IIP).
 
• The eight core industries are Coal, Crude Oil, Natural Gas, Refinery Products, Fertilizers, Steel, Cement, and Electricity.
 
• These industries are considered "core" because they have a major impact on the overall industrial performance of the Indian economy.
 
• Refinery Products have the highest weight (28.04%) among the core industries.
 
• The IIP serves as a key economic indicator for tracking industrial growth and production trends in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Core Industries and Their Weights:**

 
 
• Coal: 10.33%
 
• Crude Oil: 8.98%
 
• Natural Gas: 6.88%
 
• Refinery Products: 28.04%
 
• Fertilizers: 2.63%
 
• Steel: 17.92%
 
• Cement: 5.37%
 
• Electricity: 19.85%
 
 
 
• **Index of Industrial Production (IIP):**
 
 
• The IIP is a composite indicator that measures the growth rate of different sectors in the economy such as manufacturing, mining, and electricity.
 
• The IIP data is released monthly by the National Statistical Office (NSO) under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI).
 
 
 
• **Significance of Core Industries:**
 
 
• The performance of these industries is closely linked to the overall industrial health of the economy.
 
• Any fluctuation in the output of these industries significantly impacts the GDP growth rate.
 
 
 
• **Role in Economic Policy:**
 
 
• The government uses IIP and core industry data to frame economic policies and monitor industrial performance.
 
• The data also helps in assessing the effectiveness of industrial and fiscal policies.
